MASSIVE: primary structure is 2-3 KILOMETERS tall, the figure or ship visible at its base is dwarfed to 0.1% of its height — render scale relationships explicit.
MASSIVE: cliff face / wall / tower 500+ METERS tall, the human-scale figure at its base proves the impossible vertical scale.
COLOSSAL: primary subject occupies 70%+ of the frame at full size while still appearing distant — implying it is many kilometers across.
VAST HORIZONTAL: the city / megastructure / formation extends 5+ KILOMETERS across the horizon, fading into atmospheric perspective at its far edge — the eye cannot find the end.
PLANETARY SCALE: feature is so large it CURVES with the planet — visible curvature of horizon as the structure follows the surface, no flat ground possible.
TINY-AGAINST-INFINITE: figure rendered at 1-2% of frame against environment that fills the remaining 98%+ — the scale is so extreme it becomes the entire emotional point.
MULTI-TIER: structure has multiple visible levels stacked vertically (5+ tiers), each tier itself larger than a normal building, conveying engineered impossibility.
DEEP DEPTH: structures recede into 10+ KILOMETERS of atmospheric haze, with each depth layer adding scale. Foreground, midground, deep distance, then beyond-distance.
